metadata.title: Flexibx — AI Marketing Manager
metadata.description: An AI marketing manager that works 24/7: it understands your brand, plans your content, analyzes your results and recommends what to do next.

home.title: An AI marketing manager that works for you 24/7
home.subtitle: Flexibx builds a lasting understanding of your brand, turns it into content plans and campaigns, then learns from the results to make your next marketing better.
home.loopTitle: A marketing loop that keeps improving

brand.title: Understand your brand
brand.description: The Brand Brain remembers your identity, audience and tone of voice, so you never explain your business twice.

plan.title: Plan and create content
plan.description: 30-day content plans, posts and ads in Arabic and English, ready for review and approval.

publish.title: Schedule and publish
publish.description: A unified calendar that publishes at the right time to your social accounts.

improve.title: Analyze and improve
improve.description: Clear recommendations: what happened, why it happened and what to do next, executable in one click.

home.principle: We measure success by better marketing results, not by how much content is generated.

change.title: Change where new files go
change.explain: Only new files are affected. Existing files stay with the provider they were written to and are not moved or copied. The new provider must pass a live connection test. You can move new files away from a provider that is failing: its existing files stay there and cannot be opened or deleted until it works again.
change.leftBehind: {provider} still holds existing files and failed its connection test ({reason}). Those files were not moved: they stay on {provider} and cannot be opened or deleted until it works again.
change.unchanged: This is already the current provider.
change.stale: The settings changed meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
change.unavailable: {provider} failed its connection test, so nothing was changed. {reason}
change.confirmation_mismatch: Type the provider name exactly as shown to confirm.

storage.policy: Generated videos are deleted from storage 168 hours after generation, and their metadata 30 days after that. A provider may still bill a minimum storage period for deleted files, and copies in backups or versions are outside this policy.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Connect the accounts this workspace uses, through each platform's own sign-in. Every workspace connects its own accounts; Flexibx never asks for developer credentials.

principles.own: Your accounts and access stay in this workspace only.
principles.consent: You choose what to share on the platform's own screen, and can disconnect at any time.
principles.noSpend: Connecting never launches campaigns, sends messages or spends money: those need a separate approval.

integrations.requirementsTitle: What this platform still needs from Flexibx

requirements.META: Meta App Review (Advanced access to ads_read) and Business Verification before other businesses can connect. Launching also needs ads_management.
requirements.SNAPCHAT: A Snap Marketing API app (Organization Admin). Launching is not built.
requirements.TIKTOK: A TikTok API for Business app approved for ad account management and reporting. Launching is not built.
requirements.WHATSAPP: Meta Tech Provider onboarding with App Review (Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management) and an Embedded Signup configuration. Sending messages also needs whatsapp_business_messaging, a registered business number, approved templates and each customer's opt-in; Meta bills delivered messages.

metaDataDeletion.title: Facebook data deletion
metaDataDeletion.completed: Your data deletion request is complete. Confirmation code: {code}.

removed.title: What Flexibx deletes
removed.body: When you remove Flexibx from your Facebook settings, or ask Facebook to delete your data, Flexibx immediately disconnects every Meta ads and WhatsApp connection linked to your Facebook account, in every workspace, and erases their access tokens. For a deletion request it also erases the Facebook user id and name it stored for you. Nothing further is read from or sent to Meta with your permission. A connection you granted again after the request is a new consent and is kept.

kept.title: What the workspace keeps
kept.body: Ad plans, approvals, audit records and synced campaign results belong to the business workspace that connected its ad accounts, not to your personal Facebook profile, and stay with that workspace.

yourself.title: Do it yourself
yourself.body: In Flexibx: open the workspace's Integrations page and choose Disconnect. On Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Business integrations (or Apps and websites) → remove Flexibx. Either one revokes access immediately.

contact.title: Anything else
contact.body: To have workspace data deleted, ask the workspace owner, or contact the operator of this Flexibx service.
